# Large CSV and Fact Processing

For production extraction use the S3 Bronze pipeline; analytical reads use projected Silver SQL. Declare grain and memory model first. Filter event dates and project columns early; aggregate facts before joining them. Let DuckDB spill grouping and joins into ignored `data/duckdb_tmp`, with a configured memory limit, instead of collecting millions of keys in Python. `process_date` is processing time and cannot replace `send_date`, `event_date` or `transaction_date` in occurrence trends. Report progress at table/partition boundaries and measure peak memory on full runs.
